criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which is on FAO's membership list (see the next entry).
criteria.quote: candidates must be nationals of FAO Members

criteria.requirement: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is listed as an FAO Member.
criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

criteria.requirement: Aged between 21 and 30 at the start of the internship (it must start before the 31st birthday).
criteria.missing: Exact age, to confirm the 21-year minimum at the start of the internship.
criteria.quote: candidates should be aged between 21 and 30 at the start of their internship (i.e. internship should start before the candidate turns 31)

criteria.requirement: Enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree programme at the time of application, or a recent graduate.
criteria.applicant: Bachelor's degree (Licence) in Business Administration obtained in 2024; not recorded as enrolled.
criteria.missing: Whether a 2024 graduate counts as a 'recent graduate' (FAO does not define it), and whether the university is listed in the World Higher Education Database.
criteria.quote: candidates must be students enrolled in an under-graduate or graduate degree programme in a bona fide educational institution at the time of application, or recent graduates

criteria.requirement: Specialisation in a field relevant to FAO's work.
criteria.applicant: Business Administration degree; experience in logistics, public-sector research and vaccination-campaign monitoring.
criteria.missing: Whether the hiring office counts Business Administration as relevant to its Terms of Reference.
criteria.quote: the Programme provides FAO with the assistance of qualified individuals specializing in relevant fields

criteria.requirement: Working knowledge of at least one FAO official language (English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese or Russian).
criteria.applicant: French and English are among the recorded languages.
criteria.quote: candidates must have working knowledge of at least one FAO official language (English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese or Russian)

criteria.requirement: Appropriate residence or immigration status in the country of assignment before the internship starts.
criteria.applicant: Resident of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.missing: The country of assignment (an assignment in the DRC would meet it; elsewhere a permit or visa is needed).
criteria.quote: candidates should have appropriate residence or immigration status in the country of assignment prior to the start of the internship assignment

funding.conditions: Paid in local currency to interns not sponsored by a university or other entity; sponsored interns are paid by their sponsor.
funding.quote: Interns will receive a stipend in local currency and not exceeding US$ 700 per month.

funding.conditions: The intern (or the sponsoring institution) arranges and pays for accommodation at the duty station.
funding.quote: Interns (or their sponsoring institutions as case may be) are responsible for their own accommodation at the duty station.

funding.conditions: FAO pays the full premium for service-incurred medical coverage; interns arrange and pay their own insurance for non-service-incurred illness.
funding.quote: medical coverage related to service-incurred is provided, with FAO paying the full premium

out_of_pocket: Unknown: accommodation at the duty station and insurance for non-service-incurred illness are at the intern's expense (amounts not stated); travel to the duty station is not mentioned.
